visual_direction: Academic, clear, Kurdish-first; prioritize readability over decoration.

typography.script: Kurdish Arabic script with full Unicode support
rules: Use a font that renders Kurdish letters clearly
Keep examples large and distinct from explanations
Never substitute Arabic lookalike characters for Kurdish Unicode characters

lesson_layout.content: course number, lesson number, title, progress indicator
two or three short measurable goals
one source-based rule at a time, with citation/section note
correct/source form and contrasting form, with explanation; label disagreements between sources
two questions tied to lesson examples
multiple-choice items; answer positions validated in tests
source title and relevant section; note that the lesson is a learning aid

infographic_system.format: vertical compact infographic suitable for Telegram
avoid: mixing Course 1 Diako-only framing with Course 3 source comparison

release_checks: all rules linked to source sections
do not enable lessons before source review and bot integration tests
